newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land B up 3.6 pct on inflation news.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land B up 3.6 pct on inflation news.

text.p: Ayala Land B gained one peso, or 3.6 percent, to 29 pesos on buying triggered by news that October inflation was at 4.7 percent, lower than the market had expected, brokers said.

"Its a reaction to the lower inflation rate which means that the cost of money remains stable. Cost of money is a big item for property developers," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
Inflation in September was 4.4 percent and stock analysts had expected October inflation to go up to at least five percent.
Positioning by foreign investors on Ayala Land B shares were seen in late trade, Teresa Lee, Lippo Securities assistant vice-president said.
Volume of Ayala Land shares traded reached 3.95 million with value turnover at 113.93 million pesos.
